push.title: W 3-1 vs AC KT | You: 8.3 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your 5th best match performance of the season with an 8.3. Sweet as sun tea.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at AC KT's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ 1 key pass. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ Man of the Match, your 12th for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.
+ Tackles won 4, up from your usual 1. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ You and PhogsToffees turned simple passes into goals.

THE BAD
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Next rep: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. Brick by brick.
- 4 tackles won cost 0.2. Squeaky wheel; let's oil it.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. You're knocking on the 88%+ door.

Skill builder: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

Go put your feet up. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-1 vs AC KT | You: 8.2
push.body:
Solid shift, PhogsToffees. An 8.2 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at AC KT's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ You and BellyTb1 were on the same page, same paragraph, same sentence.
+ 10th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Better key passes than any of their humans (1 vs their best 0). Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. That's a team that believes in itself.

THE BAD
- 70% passing (16 of 23, down from your usual 83%). Keep this in your pocket: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Little by little.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 6). One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Middle of the road; 60%+ is the fast lane.
- Key passes: 1. The next level is 2+.

Garden drill: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Remember, PhogsToffees: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Every rep counts. - Coach Lasso
